title: Sketchpad Design App Scene Hover Pieces Update
description: Mouse hover in the sketchpad design app 3D scene should update the pieces to hover state. When the user hovers over a piece in the scene, it should be reflected in the hover pieces context/state.
summary: Restored deleted hover fix code. All three changes re-applied: 1) Added useThree import and invalidate() calls in GLTFMesh/FBXMesh/OBJMesh useEffect after applyHighlightToLoadedScene (needed for demand frameloop), 2) Added store?.change({ hover }) in useDesignAppHover setter to sync DesignStore alongside XState (root cause fix), 3) Added stopPropagation and ThreeEvent typing to handlePointerEnter/handlePointerLeave in ModelPiece. Build verified successful.
